pages.lesson:
LESSON: HADITH ON ETIQUETTE OF EATING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.2: Hadith on Etiquette of Eating

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Hadith on Etiquette of Eating. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What do you do before eating?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the selected hadith on appropriate manners of eating
2. demonstrate the etiquette of eating to uphold the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
3. appreciate the etiquette of eating in accordance with the teachings of the Prophet (S.A.W.)

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: HADITH ON ETIQUETTE OF EATING
This lesson teaches Hadith on Etiquette of Eating for Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. read the selected hadith on appropriate manners of eating
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. demonstrate the etiquette of eating to uphold the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the etiquette of eating in accordance with the teachings of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Hadith on Etiquette of Eating using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Hadith on Etiquette of Eating above.
2. Explain Hadith on Etiquette of Eating to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Hadith on Etiquette of Eating.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on Etiquette of Eating with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on Etiquette of Eating important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What do you do before eating?
2. What is the benefit of saying Bismillah while eating?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the selected hadith on appropriate manners of eating
2. demonstrate the etiquette of eating to uphold the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
3. appreciate the etiquette of eating in accordance with the teachings of the Prophet (S.A.W.)

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
